info.title: CallHarbor REST API
info.description: Versioned REST API v1. Every route requires a signed-in browser session. Identity comes only from that session; no route accepts a user or owner identifier. Timestamps are UTC RFC 3339 with a Z suffix. Only operations listed here are implemented.

get.summary: List the caller's AI and telephony profiles
get.description: Returns non-secret profile fields only. Endpoint URLs, headers, instructions and secret references are never returned. Telephony connectivity_status is the last read-only validation result (unknown until a validation runs). access is owner or granted.

get.summary: List the caller's calls, newest first
get.description: Keyset pagination over (created_at DESC, id DESC). Pass next_cursor back as cursor to read the next page. Cursors are opaque.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous next_cursor.

post.description: Queue one outbound call and return 202 with the queued call. The dial happens asynchronously in a bounded worker. Requires a session cookie with the CSRF token (403 forbidden on a bad token) and an Idempotency-Key header. Only a scoped OAuth token lacking mcp:call is refused 403 insufficient_scope; a browser session carries that scope. The same key with the same request returns the current call and its created_at; a different request under the same key is 409 idempotency_conflict. Refusals: invalid_input (400; malformed JSON, a body over 300 KiB, a missing Idempotency-Key, or out-of-range fields, including an E.164 to number); brief_too_large (the full session text, the AI profile's instructions with the brief and the callee notice, exceeds CALLHARBOR_MAX_CALL_BRIEF_BYTES; it is refused before queueing and never truncated); ai_profile_required (no AI profile is owned by the caller); ai_profile_ambiguous (more than one is owned; no request field selects one); not_found (unknown or ungranted telephony profile, with the same response for both); telephony_not_verified, telephony_connection_missing and telephony_webhook_key_missing (the profile is not ready for new calls); unavailable with reason calls_unavailable (HTTP 503) when the server is not running the call worker, because CALLHARBOR_PUBLIC_URL or the master key is missing. Call policy refusals, each with a stable machine prefix in the error message and no row written: destination_denied and destination_not_allowed (403; the number matches a deny prefix, or misses an allow list); max_duration_exceeds_policy (400; an explicit max_duration_seconds is above the installation or owner limit, while an omitted duration is clamped to that limit); cost_unavailable (409; a cost limit is set but no estimate rate is configured, so the cost is unknown); cost_limit_exceeded (403; the estimate for the call's duration is above the cost limit); concurrency_limit (409; the caller has the maximum number of calls in progress); global_concurrency_limit (409; the installation has the maximum in progress); rate_limited (429; the caller placed the maximum calls in the trailing hour). A refusal never writes a queued row, and a refused call is never dialed. A replay of an existing key returns the stored call even if policy has since tightened.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key that makes a retried create return the same call.

get.summary: Get one call owned by the caller
get.description: A call owned by another user is reported as not_found, the same as a missing call.

get.summary: Get one page of a call transcript owned by the caller
get.description: Returns the latest revision of each turn, in seq order, up to 100 turns per page. Each turn carries its speaker, finality, timing, fidelity and provenance; unknown provenance is null. quality_flags lists the summary flags of the call's media run, plus transcript_in_progress while the run is open, transcript_not_finalized when the call has ended without a finalized summary, and no_media_session when the call never reached a media run. Other flags in the list (for example playout_attribution_local, playout_updated, provider_id_invalid and text_truncated) are open-ended; clients must accept values they do not know. finalized is true once the run has ended. Pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page; it is empty on the last page. A call owned by another user is reported as not_found, the same as a missing call. Each read is recorded in the audit log as transcript.read.

Returns the metadata of the call's recording. Owner-scoped: a call that belongs to another user and a missing call return the same not_found. A recording that is missing, failed, deleted, or has no audio returns not_found with the message recording not available. A recording still in progress is returned with status recording and byte_count 0. The audio bytes are not returned here; download_path names the authenticated audio endpoint.

Streams the call's recording as audio/wav over authenticated REST. The body is a 44-byte WAV header followed by 16-bit stereo PCM: channel 0 is the remote party and channel 1 the agent. Supports byte ranges (bytes=a-b, a-, or -n). A single range is answered 206 with Content-Range. Several ranges are answered 206 as multipart/byteranges, as the standard library's range handling does. An unsatisfiable range is answered 416 with Content-Range bytes */size. Responses are Cache-Control: private, no-store with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. ?download=1 sends Content-Disposition attachment; otherwise it is inline. The audio is authenticated per segment; if a segment fails verification after the response has started, the server ends the response early, so the client receives fewer bytes than Content-Length and must treat the download as failed. A recording in progress returns 409 conflict. Refusals match the metadata operation.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Single byte range, for example bytes=0-1023.

206.description: Partial audio for a Range request

post.description: Ends a call on request. The owner or an administrator may hang up; other callers get not_found. A queued call is failed without a dial. A dial in flight is ended when it returns. A live call's leg is hung up and its AI session closed. Repeating the request is safe and returns the current state. Returns the call's status and outcome.

get.summary: List telephony profiles the caller owns or was granted
get.description: Owner or granted access only. Secret references are never returned.

post.description: Plaintext credentials are accepted once and stored encrypted. They are never returned. Creating a profile does not validate it.

put.description: Owner only. A change resets connectivity_status to unknown. Omitted secret values keep the stored secret.

delete.description: Owner only. Removes the profile, its grants and its secrets. Refused with 409 when calls reference it.

post.description: Checks the key, the application and the number with GET requests only. Never places a call. Stores the result as connectivity_status.

get.summary: List grants on a telephony profile

put.summary: Grant a user use of a telephony profile

get.summary: Read the caller's effective call policy
get.description: Any signed-in user. Returns the effective policy that applies to the caller. Never returns another user's overrides.

get.summary: Read a user's call policy overrides
get.description: Administrator only. Returns the stored overrides and the effective policy.

put.summary: Set a user's call policy overrides
put.description: Administrator only. Requires the CSRF token. Replaces the overrides for the user and writes an audit event. Values are validated before the write; an invalid value is refused with invalid_input and nothing is stored.

Error.description: Error envelope with a stable code

connection_id.description: Telnyx Call Control application id that calls dial through. Required on create and update. Returned to the owner only; omitted when access is granted.

connectivity_reason.description: Fixed reason code from the last validation; empty when verified or unknown.

cost.description: The call's cost. known is the provider's reported charge; estimated is the pre-dial figure from the operator's rate; unavailable means neither exists. known wins over estimated. amount is a decimal string, never a float.

TaskAssessment.description: The reasoning behind a recorded task_outcome. Present only once an outcome is recorded, and null before. source technical means no voice-session self-report was used; voice_session means the outcome rests on one. A normal hangup is never success.

TaskEvidence.description: One reference supporting a task outcome: a final transcript turn (transcript_turn) or a technical call event (call_event). It carries no transcript text. Read the callee's words at seq through the audited transcript endpoint.

met.description: Whether the session reported the criterion met. Null or omitted for call_event evidence and outcome-level quotes, which name no criterion. Only met evidence counts toward success or partial. A quote for an unmet criterion is evidence of a refusal or failure.

Fidelity.description: How far the text matches what was heard and played. played: the caller heard it as written. interrupted_text_includes_unplayed: the text includes audio that was generated but cut off before it played. playout_unconfirmed: playout could not be confirmed. not_played: generated but never played. provider_asr_approximate: approximate text from the provider's recognition or, on realtime_ws, from the voice model's out-of-band transcription (flagged caller_text_model_derived); not an exact record. unavailable: no provenance was recorded.

TimingSource.description: provider: the timeline of the voice provider's session. local_receive: when CallHarbor received the event, relative to the media start.

revision.description: The revision of this turn that is shown. A later revision replaces an earlier one; it never edits it.

quality_flags.description: Deduplicated, sorted flags for the whole call. Flags are open-ended strings; clients must tolerate unknown values.

finalized.description: True once the call's media run has ended and its transcript is final.

next_cursor.description: Opaque. Empty on the last page.

context.description: Configurable server limit; oversized input is rejected, never truncated.

instructions.description: Configurable server limit; oversized input is rejected, never truncated. The limit applies to the full session text, so an oversize request is refused before queueing.

record.description: Never enables recording unless the account owner has opted in through the WebGUI setting. Omission means no recording unless the per-user default policy enables it.

byte_count.description: Size of the WAV the audio endpoint serves: the 44-byte header plus the PCM bytes. 0 while the recording is in progress or when no audio was written.

download_path.description: Authenticated REST path, not a public URL.

sample_rate.description: Sample rate of both channels, in hertz. 0 until the writer has fixed the format.

channel_layout.description: Channel 0 is the remote party and channel 1 the agent.

quality_flags.description: Why the audio may differ from the live call. Empty when none apply.

finalized_at.description: Null until the recording is finalized.

connection_id.description: Telnyx Call Control application id that calls dial through. Required.

webhook_public_key.description: Write-only base64 Ed25519 webhook public key. Optional. Empty or omitted means no key.

connection_id.description: Telnyx Call Control application id that calls dial through. Required.

api_key.description: Write-only Telnyx API key. Optional on update: when omitted, the stored key is kept.

webhook_public_key.description: Write-only base64 Ed25519 webhook public key. Omitted or empty keeps the stored key. JSON null removes the stored key. Not allowed on create.

CallPolicyOverrides.description: Administrator overrides for one user. A null numeric field inherits the installation value. An override can only tighten the installation policy. Money is a decimal string in the installation cost currency.
